rule: Every deity has a one-word-name unique mechanic tied to faction terrain, role payoff, Momentum, Divinity, and reaction windows.
designPrinciples: Every deity can independently survive and win

deitys.name: Aten Ra
deitys.uniqueMechanic: Solar Edict: Aten Ra builds Solar Charge by using Aten-lit judgment ground, Momentum timing, and defender choices to anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation; spend 3/5 stacks for Technique riders or a one-time Signature upgrade.
deitys.basicAttack: Aten-Ra — Ma’at-Weighted Strike Anchor: Deal Aten Ra source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Solar Charge gain when used from Aten-lit judgment ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
deitys.movementAbility: Aten Hand-Ray Gate Step: traverse or manipulate Aten-lit judgment ground while leaving a tactical source-culture imprint.
deitys.defensiveAbility: Djed Bastion Frame: defensive gear expression from Solar Dominion of Khepra that mitigates only when timed around enemy intent.
deitys.offensiveAbility: Verdict Prism Rupture: spends Momentum to convert faction myth pressure into role-specific threat.
deitys.reactionAbility: Uraeus Counter-Edict: reaction window that turns enemy overcommitment into a readable counter, not real-time action.
deitys.signatureAbility: Aten-Ra: Spend stored Solar Charge to enforce Ma’at balance from Solar Dominion of Khepra: anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation. Three stacks add the Technique rider; five stacks upgrade the Signature once, then empty Solar Edict. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
deitys.divineAscension: Divine Ascension — Aten-Ra Source Radiance: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Solar Edict, transform nearby terrain into Aten-lit judgment ground, empower one Signature, and reveal Solar Dominion of Khepra as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
deitys.executionMechanic: Weigh the Name: execute vulnerable targets through Aten Ra myth law; payoff depends on archetype and terrain setup.
deitys.passive: Solar Edict: Aten Ra gains Solar Charge when defender play anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation on Aten-lit judgment ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a Ma’at balance rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Solar Dominion of Khepra.
counterplay: attack from multiple timings instead of one burst
